grammar.rule: relation := Factor [ (== | != | < | <= | > | >=) Factor ]; one optional comparison, no folding loop
grammar.precedence: Factor includes Not and parentheses; equality/order share one level above And above Or. !1<2 parses as (!1)<2, not !(1<2).
grammar.lexing: Check adjacent <=/>= before single </>; whitespace-separated < =/> = is invalid. Preserve scalar numeric token grammar and final end-of-input rejection. XML supplies < and may supply >; decoded attribute is parsed. Expanded scalar text is never reparsed as syntax.
grammar.malformed: Reject missing sides, repeated/mixed comparison chains, doubled operators, malformed parentheses and syntax in statically validated skipped sites; keep existing inherited early-validation restriction explicit.
grammar.nodeDesign: Add immutable private ordering node with four-valued operator (or an equally explicit private representation), rather than routing through equality's unequal boolean. The existing ConditionRelation equality implementation stays semantically separate.
grammar.counting: Each ordering node adds one node plus its two operands. Keep group64/node256 and existing predicate-as-one-leaf accounting; exercise reached and skipped boundaries.

requiredOrder: check either operand lacks both conversions
conversionAndEvaluation.priorityWitness: '6.1' < '6.2.0' must take version/version, because left is both numeric and version while right is version-only; treating it as numeric/version changes the result. Pair 6.1 and 6.2 exercises numeric-pair preference.
conversionAndEvaluation.reachedExpansion: Expand/unescape each reached scalar once per ordering evaluation, reuse that text for numeric then version attempts, and preserve left-before-right. Keep conversion/text cache evaluation-local; never store converted values, owner, globals, or failures in the shared raw AST cache. Order can be witnessed with invalid expanded values on different sides and failure-then-valid warm reuse, while one-pass expansion is witnessed with escaped/residual property syntax.
conversionAndEvaluation.nonScalarOperands: TryNumeric/TryVersion on predicate/operator expressions fail without invoking their Boolean evaluation. In particular, ordering an Exists/HasTrailingSlash/Not/comparison operand must not trigger its predicate or child evaluation just to obtain a number. Observe native error/fault paths rather than inventing stringification.
conversionAndEvaluation.numeric: Reuse the qualified invariant signed decimal-point and prefixed Int32-hex conversion. Preserve finite conversion, two's-complement hex, existing NaN trim and trailing-NUL distinctions, and Infinity/exponent/suffix/hex-float refusal. Reached general scalar conversions retain the ASCII boundary.
conversionAndEvaluation.version: Parse exactly 2..4 dot-separated components using source-equivalent invariant NumberStyles.Integer. Each component must parse to Int32 and be >=0. Missing Build/Revision are -1. Compare major,minor,build,revision lexicographically; do not subtract components in a way that overflows. 6.0 < 6.0.0 < 6.0.0.0 for version-pair dispatch.
conversionAndEvaluation.versionIntegerBoundary: Allow ASCII whitespace U+0009..U+000D and U+0020 around each component, one leading + or -, and negative zero when parsed result is0. Reject nonzero negative, Int32 overflow, empty components, extra components, embedded whitespace after sign, non-ASCII digits/whitespace, suffixes/exponents/hex. Number parser consumes trailing whitespace then only NUL characters; NUL before a later space is not equivalent. These are source facts, not new native observations.
conversionAndEvaluation.nulReachability: Do not place illegal literal XML NULs in ordinary native XML. Design valid-XML percent-escaped or manifest-global paths and record whether the value actually reaches Version.TryParse. Pure component-only boundaries unreachable through the chosen public evaluator remain source-based Java-only controls with zero native parity credit.
conversionAndEvaluation.mixed: Compare the version Major to the double. If Major equals number, dotted version is strictly greater, including version6.0. Equal-major truth table for operators [<,<=,>,>=]: version-left [false,false,true,true], number-left [true,true,false,false]. For unequal majors use the corresponding primitive double operator.
conversionAndEvaluation.nan: All four primitive comparisons with NaN are false, including mixed major/NaN paths. Do not implement <= or >= by negating > or < or by total-order Double.compare.
conversionAndEvaluation.equalityPreservation: Keep equality's empty-first, numeric-pair, Boolean-pair, text fallback, Not-only text fallback and three existing explicit NRE adaptations. Ordering does not add Version coercion to ==/!= and does not expose conditioned-property inventory.

errors.nonnumeric: Source MSB4086 applies if either side is neither numeric nor version. Offending-side selection is isLeftNum ? right : left, not left-valid ? right : left. A version-only left with invalid right may therefore name the valid left. Preserve native raw unexpanded/expanded message evidence and source location; choose an explicit private mapped error after capture.
errors.privateCodeProposal: CONDITION_NON_NUMERIC (new private category), subject to captured contract review; not a public InvalidProjectFileException implementation.
errors.unexpectedFaults: Do not turn any unexpected native nonfatal runtime fault into a ProjectError or guessed success. Freeze raw type/message/stack/HResult and ordered progress, review source, then either specify a distinct private adaptation with zero paired parity or block affected compatibility claims.
errors.timing: Syntax validation remains early and pure; expansion/conversion and nonnumeric errors occur only on reached evaluation. Preserve warning timing at reached parse/cache insertion, including a warning emitted before a subsequent evaluation error.

stateAndResourcePreservation: Exact raw condition key, immutable AST, no State/Path/globals/expanded fields; static validation does not warm reached cache.
Existing >3000 cache-clear threshold remains a private bounded retention policy; native eviction/concurrency not newly claimed.
First reached raw spelling owns MSB4130; repeated owner/global changes must not stale values. Ordering itself emits no new warning.
Property conditions preserve root-project directory semantics, group/import sites defining-file semantics; condition diagnostic owner remains actual attribute source.
Globals remain immutable unless explicitly root TreatAsLocalProperty; encounter-order assignments and imports use the new result naturally.
False imports skip path expansion/read; true imports retain duplicate ordering/current/first-import context and existing errors.
Private controlled sandbox remains root+15 imports, 65536 bytes/file, secured XML, immutable outputs; no new filesystem probes in scalar/version comparison.
Targets remain inert; marker absence and no build/task API checked throughout qualification.
